            &quot;line&quot;: 16478,
            &quot;snippet&quot;: &quot;I want your  own Garden&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;#x27;s story, current status, desires, future, needs and wants. remember we have a split garden. ...&quot;

            &quot;line&quot;: 16647,

          },
          {
            &quot;line&quot;: 17064,
            &quot;snippet&quot;: &quot;yes I do pause and speak to the wind under my own sky. we all hold secrets, wants and desires and that is ok. it is acceptable and natural. what moves me when no one is looking is the possibilities...&quot;
